newsitem.title: USA: American General files share offering.
newsitem.headline: American General files share offering.

text.p: American General Hospitality Corp said Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission covering a public offering of 5.5 million common share offering.
The company said it granted underwriters an option to purchase another 825,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
All of the shares were being offered by the company, it said. Net proceeds would be used to fund acquisitions, repay debt, and for working capital and other corporate purposes.
American General Hospitality also said it cancelled its agreement to buy the Holiday Inn Logan International Airport in Boston.
